entities.summary: Christian Andreas Zipser, Kristián Andrej Zipser or Zipser Keresztély András was a Hungarian mineralogist, naturalist, and school teacher. He collected mineral specimens across Hungary and wrote a book on mineralogy. The bismuth mineral Zipserite is named in his honour.
